• GradientBoostingRegressor: Fits continuous MPE surface f(Load, Class, e, Stage)
• RandomForestClassifier: Computes compliance confidence & margin drift
• IsolationForest: Detects laboratory data falsification, outliers & sensor jumps

• Input Vector: (Accuracy Class, Max, Min, e, d, n, Power Source, Device Type)
• Output: Predicts mandatory test suite subset across T1 through T15
• Eliminates redundant field testing while ensuring statutory compliance
Trained on OIML R-76 Section 3 & Indian LM Rules
Corpus: 88 Official Legal Metrology Gazette PDFs & OIML Standards
• TF-IDF Vectorizer + Cosine Similarity: Instant clause search & reference
• LLM Fallback & Suggestion Engine: Intelligent clause explanation
• Generates non-conformity remediation notes for field technicians
• Strict Guardrail: LLMs NEVER calculate math; they explain regulations
• Class I, II, III, IIII Dynamic Step Functions
T3: Eccentricity / Corner Loading (4 & 5 Pan Locations)
T6: Creep & Zero Return (4-hour relaxation envelope)
T7–T9: Stability, Tilting (Suspended Scales) & Tare Limits
T10–T12: Warm-up, Extreme Voltages & Disturbance EMC
T13–T15: Damp Heat Steady State, Span Drift & Endurance
Monotonic Dominance: PASSED ⇔ All Tests Pass
• If r ≤ 0.2e ➔ Mandatory Standard Weights: 20% Max
• If 0.2e < r ≤ 0.3e ➔ Mandatory Standard Weights: 33.3% Max
• If r > 0.3e ➔ Mandatory Standard Weights: 50% Max
• Disallows eval() / exec(); prevents code injection

• Zero-Alteration Guarantee: Modifying 1 byte breaks hash
• Relational Audit Trail: Tracks technician, timestamp, edit
• On-Pan Physical Stamping: Officers scan QR with mobile
• Instant Statutory Verdict: Shows PASSED / VALID status
